div.div: 7 انجلى It became removed, or cleared away; said of anxiety, (S, K, * TA,) and of an affair [&c.]; as also ↓ تجلّى . (K, * TA.) You say, انجلى عَنْهُ الهَمُّ Anxiety became removed, or cleared away, from him, (S,) كَمَا تَنْجَلِى الظُّلْمَةُ like as the darkness becomes removed, or cleared away. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
